about: Each playable realm's state in 300 BC. units: [heavy infantry (1,000), light infantry (1,000), archers and slingers (1,000), cavalry (500), horse archers (500), war elephants (20), warships (10)]. Sizes follow the field armies and fleets of c. 301-280 BC (Ipsus, the Pyrrhic War, the early Syrian Wars; Diodorus, Plutarch, Polybius); tribal peoples count their fighting men who could gather. treasury_years: starting silver as years of tax income. elephant_source: can raise elephants without holding elephant country (the Seleucids had Chandragupta's 500 and the Indian trade). manpower: how many times the usual share of people a realm can call up (Rome's Italian alliance; tribal levies). army_share: share of income spent on the army in peace (default 0.5; Rome, a society organised for war, more).
